action.message:
Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/main.py only. In set_key's quoting branch, backslashes are now escaped before apostrophes:

    value_out = "'{}'".format(
        value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
    )

Backslash-first ordering prevents double-escaping the escape backslashes. This matches the parser's single-quote escape set (`\\`, `\'`), so values containing literal backslashes, consecutive backslashes, apostrophes, and trailing backslashes now round-trip through dotenv_values(interpolate=False). The always/auto/never quote modes and export behavior are unchanged, and no other files were modified.

tool_call.name: finish
